verses.text: Ixlajwi chi' ix yawtankot heb' yuninal winhaj Jacob chi' smasanil, ix yalan winh: Ex wuninal, nitzekkot he b'a t'a in tz'ey. Ab'ek tas ol ex aj t'a yik b'ak'inh:
Nitzekkot he b'a t'a in tz'ey, ol walan t'ayex. Ab'ek tas ol wal a in Israel he mam in tik:
Ach Rubén, a ach ton in b'ab'el unin ach, sch'oxel sb'a wip t'ayach. Ha ach tik toxonton ay a may, niwan elk'och t'a yichanh heb' uk'tak.
Ha tiknaik, manhxalaj ol aj elk'ochi, yujto lajan ach icha junok eluma', yujto k'ixweltak ix in utej t'a in waynub' ayik ix ach way yet' ix schab'il wetb'eyum.
Ha ach tik ach Simeón yet' ach tik Leví, eyuk'tak he b'a, a eyamk'ab' yik owal ix eyak'lab'ej ayik ix he k'ulan chukal.
Junelnhej malaj in gana tzin k'och b'aj tz'och he molchajel, yujto ayik ix kot oynaj ix heyila', ix he milcham anima. Ina ayik ix kot eyowal ix he mak'k'ichaj yok nok' mam wakax.
Kotokab'kan katab' t'a eyib'anh yuj yowal he jolom chi', ina manh jab'ok tz'ok' he k'o'ol. Yuj chi' ol ex in saklemejkanb'at t'a skal heb' eyetchonhab' Israel.
Ach wuninal Judá, ol alchaj wal wach' lolonel t'ayach yuj heb' uk'tak tik. Ol ach och b'inb'in t'a sjaj heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayach. Ol em nhojjab' heb' uk'tak tik t'ayach.

Lajan ach wal icha junok nok' kelem choj, ayik slajwi schianb'at junok nok' nok' ix smila', spaxta t'a snhak'e'en. Tz'em nhojan, tz'em kutzan t'a sat lum. Icha wal junok niwakil choj, ¿mach wal junok ol stek'b'ej sb'a ach stzuntzani?
Malaj mach syal yik'anek' sniwanil elk'ochi. Malaj mach syal yik'anek' a k'okoch t'a yol a k'ab', masanto ol ja jun Mach ay yiko', jun mach to masanil nación ol k'anab'ajanok.
Ol yetzb'anoch sb'uru t'a jun yib' te' uwa yelxo wal wach', ol sjuk'an spichul t'a yal uwa.
Ha yol sat, te k'ik' yilji t'a yichanh wino, haxo k'e'en ye, yelxo wal te sak t'a yichanh nok' lech.
Ha hachxo tik ach Zabulón, ha t'a sti' ha' mar b'aj sk'och te' barco ol ach kajnajok. Ha stz'akanhil lum a lu'um, ol k'och t'a Sidón.
Ha hachxo tik ach Isacar, lajan ach icha junok nok' b'uru kuchum ikatz syik' yip t'a yol makte'.
Ayik ol ilanochi to te wach' junok lugar, wach' ol ik' ip ta', tzak'anoch yich a patik t'a yalanh ikatz, manhxalaj tas tzala' tzach ochxonhejkan chekab'ok.
Ha hachxo tik ach Dan, a ach wal ol a ch'olb'itej a chonhab' icha wal smojal tz'aj sch'olb'itaj junok makan heb' etisraelal.
Ha ach tik, lajan tzutej a b'a icha wal junok nok' ajawchan tzek' b'ak'ak'ok t'a ti b'e, to schiji yok nok' chej yuj nok', yuj chi' sjulkanel nok' mach ayk'e t'a yib'anh.
Mamin Jehová tzin tanhwej in a kolani.
Ha hachxo tik ach Gad, sk'och heb' ajk'ol yak' owal het'ok, palta slajwub'alxo ol ak' ganar heb'.
Ha hachxo tik ach Aser, ol yak'nhej sobre tas ol a wa''a. Ol ak'anpax tas ol swa heb' winh rey.
Ha hachxo tik ach Neftalí, libre aj icha junok nok' kob'es k'ultakil chej. Ha wal wach' pensaril ol ala'.
Ha hachxo tik ach José, lajan ach wal icha junok te te' ay t'a sti' junok ha ha', ste el k'uyan, manh jantakok sat syak'a', sk'axpajek' sk'ab' t'a yib'anh smakte'al.
Te ajk'ol syutej sb'a heb' anima t'ayach, sjulwaj heb' yet' sjul-lab' t'ayach, tz'och wal ijan heb' ach stzuntzani.
Ha ach tik, te ay wal yip a k'ab', te wach' yaj a jul-lab' yuj wal yip in Diosal Syalnhej yuj, haton Wilumal yet' in Kolumal a in Israel in tik,

yuj wal yip in Diosal, haton ol ach kolanok. Ha Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil ol yak' swach'k'olal t'a ib'anh, haton nhab' skot t'a satcha'anh yet' syaxil sat lum lum. Yuj swach'k'olal ol k'ib' sb'isul heb' uninal yet' nok' a molb'etzal nok'.

Ach José, masanil juntzanh wach' lolonel swalkan tik t'a ib'anh a in a mam in tik, yelxo wal te niwan yelk'och t'a yichanh wach' lolonel ix yalkan in mam t'a wib'anh, yelxo wal niwan t'a yichanh juntzanh witz aytax ek' t'a peka'. Ha masanil juntzanh tik swalkan t'a ib'anh, to sik'b'ilachkanel t'a skal heb' winh uk'tak tik.

Ha hachxo tik ach Benjamín, lajan ach wal icha junok nok' okes te ow. Ayik wan sakb'i k 'inal schianb'at schib'ej nok' smila', ayik k'ik'b'alilxo spukanb'at tas tz'ilchaj yuj, xchi winhaj Israel chi'.

Haton wal stzolal heb' lajchawanh yuninal winhaj Israel tik. Masanil juntzanh lolonel tik ix yal winh ayik ix yalankanel wach' lolonel winh t'a yib'anh junjun heb' winh yuninal chi', icha wal smojal tas ol aj junjun heb'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh yuninal chi': Toxo wal ol in chamok, yuj chi' a b'aj mukb'il heb' in mam wicham tzin he muku', haton lum manb'il t'a winhaj Efrón hitita

t'a yol yik Canaán. Ha tas ix wal tik, syalelk'ochi, haton t'a k'e'en olan k'e'en yik Macpela t'a slak'anil lum yik winhaj Mamre, manb'ilkan yuj winh ko mam kicham aj Abraham yik b'aj smukchaj schamnak winh.
Hata' smuknakkan ix Sara winh, haton ix yetb'eyum winh. Hata' mukchajnakpax winh. Hata' mukankan winh ko mam aj Isaac yet' ix ko nun ix Rebeca. Hata' in muknakpaxkan ix Lea.
Ha jun lum chi' yet' k'e'en olan k'e'en chi', manb'ilkan t'a heb' winh hitita, xchi winh t'a heb' winh yuninal chi'.
Ixlajwi yalan winh t'a heb' winh yuninal chi' yuj tas ol aj smukchaj sniwanil yuj heb' winh, ix ek' jichan winh, ix cham winh b'i'an.
